title: The daily tape · 27 August 2026
description: Daily tape · 27 Aug 2026. Country signals and sourced silicon prints. Labeled terms only — no invented 7-day moves.
og_kicker: Country conversion signals and sourced silicon prints.
lede: NVIDIA printed Q2 FY27: $96.2 billion revenue, $89.0 billion Data Center. China Hopper shipments were less than 1% of Data Center revenue, and the Q3 $108 billion outlook still assumes zero China DC compute. Georgia Power’s OpenAI Effingham contract cleared the PSC path at 3,200 MW. George Town Council approved Firmus 288 MW at Bell Bay. The Silicon Tape did not tick — Lambda H100 $3.99 / B200 $6.69, 73 confirms. PUCT 59029/59315 is still process-only; the clock is tomorrow 28 Aug.

countries.name: China
countries.note: NVIDIA Q2 FY27 (26 Aug): Data Center $89.0B. CFO EX-99.2: Hopper shipments to China <1% of Data Center revenue. Q3 outlook $108.0B ±2% assumes no Data Center compute revenue from China. Source: NVIDIA Newsroom / SEC EX-99.2.

countries.name: United States
countries.note: Georgia Power, 26 Aug: contract to serve OpenAI’s Effingham County project approved on the Georgia PSC path. 3,200 MW new demand; OpenAI pays full infrastructure cost; up to 1,000 MW flexible demand response. Source: Georgia Power / Southern Company MediaRoom.

countries.name: Australia
countries.note: George Town Council, 25 Aug: 6–1 approval of Firmus 288 MW AI data centre at Long Reach / former Gunns mill, Bell Bay. Conditions plus 14-day TASCAT appeal window. Diesel gensets corrected to 276. Source: ABC News.

countries.name: India
countries.note: AM Intelligence (Greenko promoters), 25 Aug: firm order for 9,000 NVIDIA Rubin GPUs as Vera Rubin NVL72 at a 30 MW Hyderabad AI factory, delivery Q1 2027. First tranche of a planned 1 GW CaaS book; near-term 200 MW / >$8B; 5 GW powered sites cited across India, the US and Europe. ~450 exaFLOPS NVFP4 inference (company). Source: The Hindu / PTI reprint of the company release.

countries.name: United States
countries.note: Lancium (The Woodlands; Blackstone), 24 Aug: NVIDIA strategic collaboration plus an undisclosed NVIDIA investment. 4 GW leased, >15 GW powered-land pipeline, DSX MaxLPS / DSX Flex. Not a named campus FID; NVIDIA IR has not posted a matching note. Distinct from PORTS-Pike. Source: Lancium PR.

countries.name: United States
countries.note: SOAH PFD in PUCT 59475 Item 6441, filed 1:52 PM 20 Aug (SOAH 473-26-16349): ALJs Brite, Burgess, and Chico recommend the Commission deny Oncor/LCRA Import Path 2 — Bell County East–Big Hill and Big Hill–Sand Lake 765-kV. Need not proven under PURA § 37.056; ~1,400 landowners missed Rule 22.52(a)(4) public-meeting process; ERCOT’s PBRP “is not entitled to great weight.” If a route is later selected, ALJs recommend Route 894. This is a proposal for decision, not a Commission order. Exceptions / OM date still to be set. Source: PUCT Interchange 59475 Item 6441.

countries.name: United States
countries.note: PUCT Project 59142 Item 53, filed 12:29 PM 20 Aug: order granting ERCOT good-cause exceptions from 16 TAC § 25.361(b)(16). Delay classifying Large Loads (≥75 MW) past the 7 Aug Planning Guide deadline; allow eligible-but-unclassified base loads into the 1 Aug and 1 Nov QSAs; 24-day cure on late dynamic-data review. Verification and audit must be completed and reported before Batch Zero continues. Community-impact RFIs to unenergized DC/crypto ≥25 MW. Minutes still unposted. Source: PUCT Interchange 59142_53.

countries.name: United States
countries.note: ERCOT’s Item 52 (09:01 20 Aug) still holds the working clocks the order does not restate: 17 large DC/crypto loads / 6,608 MW paused at energization; QSA 6 loads ≈1,959 MW and 17 ≈6,874 MW; reports 10 Dec, Open Meeting 17 Dec. April snapshot 157 medium loads ≈8,766 MW. Source: ERCOT / PUCT Interchange 59142_52.

countries.name: United States
countries.note: Governor Shapiro signed EO 2026-05 on 18 Aug, effective immediately: DEP Consent Order for any data center over 25 MW peak, Fast Track removal, NDA ban, GRID-tied sales-tax exemption. Recitals: 20 DEP applications, PJM 74 GW through 2045. Source: Commonwealth of Pennsylvania.

countries.name: United States
countries.note: Amazon (18 Aug) raised northwest Louisiana from $12B to $18B and added a third STACK campus in Shreveport. SWEPCO 100% of new energy infra; up to $400M water on Amazon’s tab. IT-MW not disclosed. Source: Amazon.

countries.name: China
countries.note: FT (19 Aug): ByteDance and Tencent each ~10,000 H200s; Beijing steering most volume to Hong Kong. No new BIS/NDRC/IR primary on 25 Aug. Already on The Wire.
